recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future deprecation or redesign of device-implantStatus should proceed through FHIR-29776 or a successor FHIR-extensions ticket; no core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-11108.
issue_request: FHIR-11108 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 Device.status, requesting more status coverage for implantables and suggesting an implantableDeviceStatus value set.
initial_application: The source history has no explicit FHIR-11108 tag, but commit 2bd8c95642d3c1f3609ca70c5b6678a874b8de35 applied the same GForge issue family [#11105]-[#11109] in 2017 by adding a Device implant-status extension/value set with functional, non-functional, disabled, and unknown and by changing Device examples from available/not-available to active/inactive.
additional_context: FHIR-15846 later confirmed the implantStatus extension should not be a modifier. FHIR-21235, FHIR-32557, FHIR-38904, FHIR-48532, and FHIR-48713 separated Device record status from availability, operational, and association state, introduced DeviceAssociation, and added associationStatus codes including implanted, explanted, attached, on, off, standby, defective, and abandoned. Core extension sources were removed from the FHIR core checkout in 2023 and the device-implantStatus extension and terminology now live in the FHIR Extension Pack. FHIR-29776 remains unresolved about whether implantStatus is obsolete or should be reshaped in light of DeviceAssociation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Device.status is currently defined as the Device record status; DeviceAssociation is active in the current build and carries associationStatus for implant/device association state; and the original functional implantStatus extension exists outside core in the Extension Pack. Reintroducing implantable values into Device.status or copying the extension back into core would conflict with later applied decisions and the repository split.

related_jiras.note: Confirmed the implantStatus extension should not be marked as a modifier.
Separated active/inactive device records from implanted/explanted state and proposed operational/association status handling.
Clarified Device.status as record status and directed other device state to availability, operational, and association concepts.
Moved patient/device association out of Device into DeviceAssociation.
Split DeviceAssociation.status from associationStatus and added association-state codes.
Added abandoned for implantable devices left in a patient's body.
Unresolved FHIR-extensions ticket considering whether implantStatus is now obsolete or overtaken by DeviceAssociation.
